item.title: The Ebola crisis is far outpacing the response, Congo's IRC director says
item.description: Health workers battling the ongoing Ebola outbreak in Congo are hindered by lack of data, budget cuts and a fearful community.

item.title: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
item.description: Patients travel miles to be treated at public hospitals in Delhi. Those in need get financial aid for their care. But for overnight accommodations, families are often on their own — and on the street.
item.content:encoded:
Patients travel miles to be treated at public hospitals in Delhi. Those in need get financial aid for their care. But for overnight accommodations, families are often on their own — and on the street.
